mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP growth rate indicates a robust economy, leading to higher consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances with strong GDP growth, or the correlation between GDP growth and S&P 500 returns is not significant (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances with high federal funds rates, or the federal funds rate does not Granger-cause S&P 500 returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate below 3.5% indicates a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances with low unemployment, or the correlation between unemployment and S&P 500 returns is not significant (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production indicates a strong supply chain, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances with strong industrial production growth, or the correlation between industrial production and S&P 500 returns is not significant (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in housing starts and a low unemployment rate indicate a robust economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances with strong housing starts and low unemployment, or the interaction term between housing starts and unemployment is not significant (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% and a strong increase in GDP growth rate indicate a tightening monetary cycle with a strong economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances with high federal funds rates and strong GDP growth, or the interaction term between federal funds rate and GDP growth is not significant (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate below 3.5% and a strong increase in payroll employment indicate a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances with low unemployment and strong payroll employment growth, or the interaction term between unemployment and payroll employment is not significant (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in personal consumption expenditures and a low unemployment rate indicate a robust economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances with strong personal consumption expenditures growth and low unemployment, or the interaction term between personal consumption expenditures and unemployment is not significant (p > 0.1).
